author: The Infographics Show
description:
Some of America’s most wanted fugitives haven’t been seen for decades. Others may be living ordinary lives under new identities, thousands of miles from the crimes they are accused of committing.

This video explores the shocking stories behind Americans sought internationally through INTERPOL Red Notices and other law enforcement investigations. From suspected murderers and violent robbers to fugitives convicted of serious crimes, these cases reveal just how difficult it can be to bring someone home to face justice. Meet Robert William Fisher, wanted in connection with the murder of his family, Jason Derek Brown, accused of killing an armored car guard during a robbery, and Bradford Bishop, the former U.S. diplomat who disappeared after the murders of five family members in 1976. Other cases involve suspects who fled overseas, changed their names, or became caught in complicated extradition disputes between countries.
